title: Compression provider contract
deliverable: Standardize streaming encoder/decoder state, trailing-data policy, dictionary limits and byte counters.
acceptance: Truncated streams and short output buffers resume or fail deterministically without hiding retained state.

title: Deflate
deliverable: Add raw Deflate compression/decompression and reference parameter mapping.
acceptance: Stored, fixed and dynamic blocks pass reference fixtures across all tested chunk boundaries.

title: Zlib
deliverable: Add wrappers, dictionary handling and checksums with strict and compatibility framing policies.
acceptance: Header, dictionary-ID and checksum failures are distinguished; limits include dictionary memory.

title: Gzip
deliverable: Add gzip metadata, concatenated members, checksums and deterministic-output options.
acceptance: Member boundaries and trailing garbage follow documented semantics; preview cannot skip final integrity validation.

title: Bzip2
deliverable: Deliver required compression/decompression variants through a reviewed provider.
acceptance: Block limits, corrupt indexes and expansion attacks are tested in browser and native builds.

title: LZMA and containers
deliverable: Add the inventory’s LZMA/container variants with configurable but bounded dictionaries.
acceptance: Dictionary size is validated before allocation; unsupported container variants remain named gaps.

title: LZ4
deliverable: Add required block/frame operations, checksums and content-size handling.
acceptance: Frame flags, dictionaries, short blocks and independent/dependent block behavior match fixtures.

title: LZ string encodings
deliverable: Add LZ-based string and transport variants present in the reference.
acceptance: UTF-16/code-unit behavior is reproduced explicitly rather than replaced with a superficially similar byte codec.

title: Platform compression families
deliverable: Add NT/XPRESS and other inventoried platform-specific formats without calling local shell utilities.
acceptance: Published/reference samples and malformed streams work identically in the browser and native engine.

title: ZIP listing and extraction
deliverable: Add multi-entry archives, data descriptors, name encodings and password variants required by inventory.
acceptance: Entry count, expansion, encryption errors and path normalization are bounded; extraction never writes arbitrary host paths.

title: ZIP creation
deliverable: Add selected compression methods, metadata mapping and deterministic archive options.
acceptance: Round trips preserve required names and bytes; archives larger than basic format limits use supported extensions or fail clearly.

title: TAR operations
deliverable: Add listing, extraction and creation for required header variants and links.
acceptance: Traversal, absolute paths, devices, symlinks and hardlinks cannot bypass the artifact namespace.

title: Nested archive workflows
deliverable: Connect archive outputs to file collections and bounded recursive processing.
acceptance: Total nesting, members, bytes and work are capped across the whole job, not reset per nested archive.

title: Archive UX and integrity
deliverable: Add per-member inspection, safe selection, artifact exports and verification status.
acceptance: Incomplete or checksum-failed outputs never appear as verified; selected member export preserves authorization.

title: Compression qualification
deliverable: Close all compression inventory gaps and run corpus-based fuzzing and expansion stress tests.
acceptance: Every provider declares measured memory profiles; unsupported methods cannot be omitted from the parity denominator.
